intro: Sathrah's Sacrifice consists of the silvery spinnerets taken from Lady Sathrah, a mighty spider dwelling in Teldrassil. Entrusted to adventurers by Priestess A'moora, this offering is presented at the fountain of the Temple of the Moon to cleanse the creature's corruption and lay her spirit to rest.

p: Lady Sathrah was once a venerable creature of Teldrassil who fell prey to the creeping madness and corruption afflicting the boughs of the great tree. Tasked by the Sisterhood of Elune, adventurers retrieve her silvery spinnerets not as mere trophies, but as a consecrated offering. By bathing these remains within the sacred fountain of the Temple of the Moon, the foul taint that poisoned Sathrah's mind is washed away. The rite frees her troubled soul, allowing her spirit to manifest peacefully within the sanctuary and granting her the promise of rebirth under Elune's grace.
